Substance: 3-MeO-PCE                         Author: AB
Dose: 30mg I.M.                                    Gender: M 186lb
I found myself fortunate enough to receive samples of various novel compounds including 3-MeO-PCE. On the morning it arrived I dissolved 30mg in sterile water and injected intramuscularly. Having had extensive experience with ketamine and some DXM experiences as well as psychedelics and opioids (3-MeO-PCE is said to have some affinity for opioid receptors) I had some idea of what to expect.
The main difference I noticed between this compound and ketamine was the speed of onset and duration. In my experience ketamine kicks in quite quickly, peaks and tails off within a couple of hours. 3-MeO-PCE seems to creep up slowly, so much so that I didn't notice I was intoxicated until I stood up at which point colours seemed to be brighter and my coordination was moderately impaired. It also seems to be slightly stimulating and allowedme to move around to more of a degree than ketamine.
Overall, I found the compound to be interesting enough to warrant further investigation though less recreational than ketamine or DXM. There was no compulsion to redose and I would even describe the material as mildly dysphoric.
